defs.meaning: 考试；审查，调查；医学检查；<法律>讯问，查问

examples.en: Your proposals are still under examination.
examples.zh: 你的提议仍在审查之中。

examples.en: You will need to have a routine biannual examination.
examples.zh: 你需要做一年两次的常规检查。

examples.en: All students without exception must take the English examination.
examples.zh: 所有学生都必须参加英语考试，无一例外。
